title: fix(plugin-chatbot): keep a 16px gutter in the docked AI panel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBXim82sEGBUBXqH4hkWyBJX)_
Fixes #34609

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This card is one item of epic #34571 (console core-workflow experience). It keeps the right-docked panel as the canonical presentation (ui ADR-0057 §3) and only fixes the gutter inside it.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:AI 助手的 plain 表面(右侧停靠面板、整页 `/ai`、分享记录页共用)的左右内边距改为按聊天区自身宽度判断(容器查询),不再按浏览器窗口宽度;窄面板里正文、表格、输入框左右统一 16px,助手回复占满这一列。
- **为什么改**:原来的 `sm:px-0` 是视口断点,桌面窗口下一律把内边距归零,420px 的停靠面板里文字和输入框贴边。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 Tailwind 类名,不动数据与接口;聊天区宽度达到 48rem 起与原版式逐像素一致(实测 780/900/1100px 三档前后相同);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`(`PLAIN_SURFACE_GUTTER` / `PLAIN_SURFACE_ASSISTANT_WIDTH` 两个常量、根节点的 `@container`、助手 `Message` 的 className 一处)。
- **两分钟验证**:桌面窗口打开控制台,右侧打开 AI 助手面板(约 420px),问一个会返回表格的问题:正文、表格框、输入框距面板两边各 16px;表格列多时在自己的框内横向滚动,不越出面板。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- The plain chat surface's root is now a Tailwind size container (`@container`). The message list and the composer share one gutter, `PLAIN_SURFACE_GUTTER` (`px-4 @3xl:px-0`): 16px on both sides until the CHAT (not the viewport) is 48rem wide, where the centred `max-w-2xl` (42rem) column already has more than 16px around it. This replaces the two `sm:px-0` viewport breakpoints that zeroed the gutter inside a ~420px dock on every desktop window.
- On the plain surface, an assistant turn spans the column below `@3xl` (`PLAIN_SURFACE_ASSISTANT_WIDTH`, `max-w-full @3xl:max-w-[95%]`), so its prose, tables and cards end on the same 16px line as the composer. The user bubble keeps its 95% cap. At full width the bubble's usual cap is unchanged.
- The card surface (`surface="card"`, the default) is untouched: no `@container`, same `px-4 py-3` list, same bubble width.
- Tables: no code change was needed. Streamdown already draws each table inside its own `overflow-x-auto` box within the answer; measured below, a wide 4-column table stays inside the panel and scrolls horizontally to its last column. The new pins hold that.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/chatAnswerLayout-13032.test.tsx`, the package's shared side-panel answer-layout harness (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness file goes into that file), named for this card: the plain root is an `@container`; the list and the composer carry `px-4 @3xl:px-0` and no viewport-breakpoint padding; an assistant turn carries `max-w-full @3xl:max-w-[95%]` while the user bubble keeps `max-w-[95%]`; a 4-column table renders inside an `overflow-x-auto` box inside the table wrapper; control: the card surface keeps its own chrome and bubble width. happy-dom evaluates no container query, so the suite pins the class contract; the geometry was measured in Chromium (Verification).

Reverse verification (one-off, not committed): with the fix committed, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` was restored from the base commit `97defd606` (tree only; `sm:px-0` count 2, `PLAIN_SURFACE_GUTTER` count 0), the suite ran red (2 failed, 31 passed: the gutter pin and the assistant-width pin), then `git checkout HEAD -- ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and a matching HEAD blob hash. The table-box pin and the card control stay green on both trees, as preservation pins should.

## Acceptance notes

- Card premise, item 1 holds on this tree. Item 2's "table runs ~7px past the panel's right edge" did not reproduce here: on `97defd606` the table box already stayed inside the answer and scrolled (measured below); what read as clipping is the scroll box's own edge cutting the last column, which scrolls into view. This PR therefore changes no table code; with the gutter back, the table box ends 16px from the panel edge.
- Mid widths change on purpose: a chat narrower than 48rem now keeps the 16px gutter even on a wide viewport (e.g. a 700px column: content 640px with 30px margins, was 638px with 14/47px). On a phone the assistant turn now spans the column instead of 95%.
- Observation, not filed: in a narrow box, a table whose FIRST column holds a long unbroken value (an e-mail address) makes the frozen first column (the sticky-column rule from the earlier side-panel card) take most of the box, so the other columns scroll under it in a narrow strip. Pre-existing, outside this card.
- Local verification was narrowed and is declared: the shared verify lock was held for over 40 minutes by a sibling run, so the plugin-chatbot type-check and the 7 test files that render the plain/card chat ran outside the lock at one worker; the full package suite and the Test UI lanes are CI's.

## Verification

Measured in Chromium (Playwright, `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) on markup rendered by the real `ChatbotEnhanced` (`surface="plain"`, one user turn, one assistant turn with a 4-column table) under the console's own compiled stylesheet (`ui/apps/console/src/index.css` through `@tailwindcss/postcss`), hosted in the dock's flex chain at a 1280px viewport. Distances in px from the panel's left / right edge.

| 420px panel | base `97defd606` | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| body paragraph | 0 / 20 | 16 / 16 |
| table box | 0 / 20 | 16 / 16 |
| composer | 0 / 0 | 16 / 16 |
| user bubble right edge | 0 | 16 |

Wide 4-column table (long unbroken values), this branch: scroll box `clientWidth` 367, `scrollWidth` 656, `overflow-x: auto`; scrolled to the end, the last cell ends 1px (the border) inside the box; page `scrollWidth` stays 1280.

Full width: at 780, 900 and 1100px chat widths every measured box (paragraph, assistant turn, user bubble, table box, composer) is identical before and after.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 0e91b7392)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` over `chatAnswerLayout-13032`, `ChatbotEnhanced`, `ChatbotEnhanced.promptHeaderSlot-12978`, `ChatbotEnhanced.surfaceContextTitle-8219`, `renderer.surface`, `FloatingChatbot`, `FloatingChatbot.classNameMerge-8078`: Test Files 7 passed (7), Tests 144 passed (144).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citation(s), exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two changed source files: 0 errors (12 pre-existing warnings, none on changed lines).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 38 commands; the derived `check:*` / script self-tests ran locally, results in the report.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: clean against `origin/main`, and against #34539 named explicitly (no longer open).

</details>
